name: Chart/Bar-Chart
description:
Bar chart: one measure per period or category. Vertical: 12 columns on a dashed grid (solid baseline), bars ≤40px with Corner-Radius/Small in Chart/Sector/Primary, the active bar Chart/Sector/Secondary with its Tooltip and X pill, projected bars hatched (.Chart/Hatch). Horizontal: category pills, 24px bars over a hatched target track, a value axis. Header: icon, title, open chevron, description, value, ranges. Content only, no surface of its own: place it in a Chart-Card's (or a Card's) Content slot, and the card gives the theme. Code: BarChart + ChartCard (src/components/Chart)

Color: Primary (default) · Secondary — Secondary swaps Color Chart Sector/Primary and /Secondary (Secondary bars, the active bar Primary), for a chart led by Neutral Deep with the brand as its highlight. Code: palette="secondary".
